room_only: Use this command inside a room.
usage_hint: without a URL, the latest voice note in this room is used
disabled: Voice transcription is currently turned off by the owner.
no_backend: No transcription service available. Set a GROQ, MISTRAL or GEMINI API key in the config.
no_audio: No recent voice note in this room. Provide an audio URL: transcribe <url>
not_audio: That URL is not a valid audio file.
busy: Too many transcription requests, please wait a moment.
mod_only: Access denied: this command is for room owners/admins/moderators only.
owner_only: Access denied: global commands are for the bot owner only.
